criteria_verification.evidence: Created tests/integration/test_adapter_lifecycle.py with two integration tests. The nats_server fixture spawns the local nats-server binary as a subprocess on a random free port with JetStream enabled and an isolated store_dir. The bootstrapped_server fixture provisions the agent-registry KV bucket (mirroring nats-infrastructure/kv/provision-kv.sh). test_full_lifecycle_round_trip exercises: (a) adapter.start(); (b) reads agent-registry via client.get_fleet_registry() and asserts the manifest is present mid-lifecycle; (c) publishes a COMMAND envelope via nc.request() and verifies the round-tripped ResultPayload comes back through the reply inbox; (d) calls adapter.stop(); (e) re-reads the KV bucket and asserts the manifest has been removed. test_heartbeat_published_on_live_server additionally verifies a real heartbeat envelope arrives on fleet.heartbeat.<agent_id>. Both tests pass against a live nats-server v2.12.8: `pytest tests/integration/test_adapter_lifecycle.py` → 2 passed in 0.28s.
